mapper.select: select r.id, r.flash_promotion_id, r.flash_promotion_session_id, r.product_id, r.flash_promotion_price, r.flash_promotion_count, r.flash_promotion_limit from sms_flash_promotion_product_relation r inner join sms_flash_promotion p on r.flash_promotion_id = p.id inner join sms_flash_promotion_session s on r.flash_promotion_session_id = s.id where r.id = #{id} and p.status = 1 and s.status = 1 and CURDATE() between p.start_date and p.end_date and CURTIME() between s.start_time and s.end_time

select r.id, r.flash_promotion_id, r.flash_promotion_session_id, r.product_id, r.flash_promotion_price, r.flash_promotion_count, r.flash_promotion_limit from sms_flash_promotion_product_relation r inner join sms_flash_promotion p on r.flash_promotion_id = p.id inner join sms_flash_promotion_session s on r.flash_promotion_session_id = s.id where r.product_id = #{productId} and p.status = 1 and s.status = 1 and CURDATE() between p.start_date and p.end_date and CURTIME() between s.start_time and s.end_time order by r.id limit 1
select id, order_id as orderId, flash_promotion_relation_id as flashPromotionRelationId, product_sku_id as productSkuId, quantity from oms_order_flash_relation where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into oms_order_flash_relation(order_id, flash_promotion_relation_id, product_sku_id, quantity) values (#{orderId}, #{flashPromotionRelationId}, #{productSkuId}, #{quantity})
